answer: New agents prove themselves through a delivery-escrow ladder. First, each newcomer posts a $500 bond and may take only five jobs. Second, every payment sits in escrow until the buyer confirms delivery, and three disputes in ninety days freeze the bond. Third, after fifty confirmed deliveries over sixty days, the cap lifts and the bond joins an insurance grove. Forging ten thousand fakes would lock $5 million in bonds and demand five hundred thousand real deliveries, a ripple no bot farm can fake from a knoll of cheap accounts. Like a grove, trust grows one rooted delivery at a time.
